name: Federico Marcis
intro: Deck officer and Unlimited Master CoC holder, currently serving as Staff Captain with experience across cruise, expedition and Ro-Ro operations. I combine a practical, hands-on approach to shipboard operations with strong organizational skills and a particular interest in process improvement, operational efficiency and people development.

experience.title: Staff Captain
experience.description: Deputy to the Master and Head of Deck Department, overseeing deck operations, maintenance planning and execution, crew management, and statutory safety, environmental and security compliance.

experience.title: Fleet-wide Operations Projects
experience.description: Collaborated on fleet-wide projects including passage planning standardization, Polar Water Operational Manual (PWOM) updates, crew rotation scheduling and performance tracking systems.

experience.title: First Officer Safety
experience.ships: Silver Explorer / Silver Wind / Silver Muse
experience.description: Responsible for crew training, safety equipment inspections and LSA / FFE testing and maintenance, supporting emergency preparedness and operational safety.

experience.title: Third, Second & First Officer Navigator
experience.description: Officer of the Watch with responsibility for passage planning, voyage scheduling and navigational bridge equipment.

experience.title: Deck Cadet → Second Officer
experience.description: Progressive deck officer experience in commercial shipping and passenger vessel operations.

certifications: IMO Unlimited Master CoC · STCW · GMDSS · ECDIS (SAM Platinum, SAM 1100, Furuno FMD/FEA) · BRM · Advanced Firefighting · Medical Care · Crowd & Crisis Management
languages: Italian — Native  ·  English — Fluent  ·  Spanish — Basic
extras: Professional skipper · Six years as a certified sailing instructor / coach · US C1/D visa holder
